name: Mental Revenge
source:
Take justice into your own hands (or… your penis) after discovering your wife’s betrayal right under your roof. With the help of a persuasive psychologist, you’ll explore a series of charged, mind‑bending encounters as you plot an epic revenge.

But watch your back—can you pull off the ultimate payback without losing yourself in the process?

[From [url=https://mindusky-support2.itch.io/mental-revenge]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在发现妻子在你的屋檐下遭到背叛后，将正义掌握在你自己的手中（或者……你的阴茎）。在一位有说服力的心理学家的帮助下，当你策划一场史诗般的复仇时，你将探索一系列充满激情、令人费解的遭遇。

但要小心——你能在不迷失自我的情况下获得最终回报吗？

[来自[url=https://mindusky-support2.itch.io/mental-revenge]itch.io[/url]]
